H1300.def: from «01299»; lightning; by analogy, a gleam; concretely, a flashing sword:--bright, glitter(-ing sword), lightning.

H1301.def: the same as «01300»; Barak, an Israelite:--Barak.

H1302.def: of uncertain derivation; Barkos, one of the Nethimim:--Barkos.

H1303.def: from «01300»; a thorn (perhaps as burning brightly):--brier.

H1304.def: or barkath {baw-rek-ath'}; from «01300»; a gem (as flashing), perhaps the emerald:--carbuncle.

H1305.def: a primitive root; to clarify (i.e. brighten), examine, select:--make bright, choice, chosen, cleanse (be clean), clearly, polished, (shew self) pure(-ify), purge (out).

H1306.et: probably from (07562) with a prepositional prefix
H1306.def: probably from «07562» with a prepositional prefix; with wickedness; Birsha, a king of Gomorrah:--Birsha.

H1307.def: patrial from «01268»; a Berothite, or inhabitant of Berothai:--Berothite.

H1308.def: from «01319»; cheerful; Besor, a stream of Palestine:--Besor.

H1309.def: or (shortened) bsorah {bes-o-raw'}; feminine from «01319»; glad tidings; by implication, reward for good news:--reward for tidings.

H1310.def: a primitive root; properly, to boil up; hence, to be done in cooking; figuratively to ripen:--bake, boil, bring forth, roast, seethe, sod (be sodden).

H1312.def: of foreign derivation; Bishlam, a Pers.:--Bishlam.

H1313.et: from an unused root meaning to be fragrant
H1313.def: from an unused root meaning to be fragrant; (compare «05561») the balsam plant:--spice.

H1314.def: or bosem {bo'-sem}; from the same as «01313»; fragrance; by implication, spicery; also the balsam plant:--smell, spice, sweet (odour).

H1315.def: feminine of «01314» (the second form); fragrance; Bosmath, the name of a wife of Esau, and of a daughter of Solomon:-- Bashemath, Basmath.

H1316.def: of uncertain derivation; Bashan (often with the article), a region East of the Jordan:--Bashan.

H1318.def: a primitive root; to trample down:--tread.

H1319.def: a primitive root; properly, to be fresh, i.e. full (rosy, (figuratively) cheerful); to announce (glad news):--messenger, preach, publish, shew forth, (bear, bring, carry, preach, good, tell good) tidings.

H1320.def: from «01319»; flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphem.) the pudenda of a man:--body, (fat, lean) flesh(-ed), kin, (man-)kind, + nakedness, self, skin.

H1322.def: from «0954»; shame (the feeling and the condition, as well as its cause); by implication (specifically) an idol:--ashamed, confusion, + greatly, (put to) shame(-ful thing).

H1323.def: from «01129» (as feminine of «01121»); a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively):--apple (of the eye), branch, company, daughter, × first, × old, + owl, town, village.

H1324.def: probably from the same as «01327»; a bath or Hebrew measure (as a means of division) of liquids:--bath.

H1326.def: probably an orthographical variation for «01327»; desolation:--waste.

H1327.et: from an unused root (meaning to break in pieces)
H1327.def: feminine from an unused root (meaning to break in pieces); desolation:--desolate.

H1328.et: apparently from the same as (01326) and (0410)
H1328.def: apparently from the same as «01326» and «0410»; destroyed of God; Bethuel, the name of a nephew of Abraham, and of a place in Palestine:--Bethuel. Compare «01329».

H1329.def: for «01328»; Bethul (i.e. Bethuel), a place in Palestine:--Bethuel.

H1330.et: pass. participle of an unused root meaning to separate
H1330.def: feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to separate; a virgin (from her privacy); sometimes (by continuation) a bride; also (figuratively) a city or state:--maid, virgin.

H1331.et: masculine plural of the same as (01330)
H1331.def: masculine plural of the same as «01330»; (collectively and abstractly) virginity; by implication and concretely, the tokens of it:--X maid, virginity.

H1332.def: from «01323» and «03050»; daughter (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Bithjah, an Egyptian woman:--Bithiah.

H1333.def: a primitive root; to cut in pieces:--thrust through.

H1334.def: a primitive root, to chop up:--divide.

H1336.def: the same as «01335»; Bether, a (craggy) place in Palestine:--Bether.

H1337.et: from (01323) and a masc. pl. from (07227)
H1337.def: from «01323» and a masculine plural from «07227»; the daughter (i.e. city) of Rabbah:--Bath-rabbim.

H1338.def: from «01334»; (with the article) the craggy spot; Bithron, a place East of the Jordan:--Bithron.

H1339.def: from «01323» and «07651» (in the sense of «07650»); daughter of an oath; Bath-Sheba, the mother of Solomon:--Bath- sheba.

H1340.def: from «01323» and «07771»; daughter of wealth; Bath-shua, the same as «01339»:--Bath-shua.

H1342.def: a primitive root; to mount up; hence, in general, to rise, (figuratively) be majestic:--gloriously, grow up, increase, be risen, triumph.

H1345.def: from «01342» and «0410»; majesty of God; Geuel, an Israelite:--Geuel.

H1346.def: from «01342»; arrogance or majesty; by implication, (concretely) ornament:--excellency, haughtiness, highness, pride, proudly, swelling.

H1347.def: from «01342»; the same as «01346»:--arrogancy, excellency(-lent), majesty, pomp, pride, proud, swelling.

H1348.def: from «01342»; the same as «01346»:--excellent things, lifting up, majesty, pride, proudly, raging.

H1350.def: a primitive root, to redeem (according to the Oriental law of kinship), i.e. to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property, marry his widow, etc.):--X in any wise, × at all, avenger, deliver, (do, perform the part of near, next) kinsfolk(-man), purchase, ransom, redeem(-er), revenger.

H1351.def: a primitive root, (rather identified with «01350», through the idea of freeing, i.e. repudiating); to soil or (figuratively) desecrate:--defile, pollute, stain.

H1353.def: feminine passive participle of «01350»; redemption (including the right and the object); by implication, relationship:--kindred, redeem, redemption, right.

H1354.def: from an unused root meaning to hollow or curve; the back (as rounded (compare «01460» and «01479»); by analogy, the top or rim, a boss, a vault, arch of eye, bulwarks, etc.:--back, body, boss, eminent (higher) place, (eye)brows, nave, ring.

H1356.def: from «01461»; a log (as cut out); also well or cistern (as dug):--beam, ditch, pit.

H1357.def: probably from «01461» (compare «01462»); a locust (from its cutting):--locust.

H1358.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «01461»; a pit (for wild animals) (as cut out):--den.

H1359.def: or (fully) Gowb {gobe'}; from «01461»; pit; Gob, a place in Palestine:--Gob.

H1360.def: from an unused root meaning probably to collect; a reservoir; by analogy, a marsh:--marish, pit.

H1361.def: a primitive root; to soar, i.e. be lofty; figuratively, to be haughty:--exalt, be haughty, be (make) high(-er), lift up, mount up, be proud, raise up great height, upward.

H1363.def: from «01361»; elation, grandeur, arrogance:--excellency, haughty, height, high, loftiness, pride.

H1364.def: or (fully) gabowahh {gaw-bo'-ah}; from «01361»; elevated (or elated), powerful, arrogant:--haughty, height, high(-er), lofty, proud, × exceeding proudly.

H1366.def: or (shortened) gbul {gheb-ool'}; from «01379»; properly, a cord (as twisted), i.e. (by implication) a boundary; by extens. the territory inclosed:--border, bound, coast, × great, landmark, limit, quarter, space.

H1367.def: or (shortened) gbulah {gheb-oo-law'}; feminine of «01366»; a boundary, region:--border, bound, coast, landmark. place.

H1368.def: or (shortened) gibbor {ghib-bore'}; intensive from the same as «01397»; powerful; by implication, warrior, tyrant:-- champion, chief, × excel, giant, man, mighty (man, one), strong (man), valiant man.

H1369.et: pass. participle from the same as (01368)
H1369.def: feminine passive participle from the same as «01368»; force (literally or figuratively); by implication, valor, victory:-- force, mastery, might, mighty (act, power), power, strength.

H1371.def: from an unused root meaning to be high (in the forehead); bald in the forehead:--forehead bald.

H1372.def: from the same as «01371»; baldness in the forehead; by analogy, a bare spot on the right side of cloth:--bald forehead, × without.

H1373.def: from the same as «01354»; collective:--Gabbai, an Israelite:--Gabbai.

H1374.def: plural of «01356»; cisterns; Gebim, a place in Palestine:--Gebim.

H1375.def: from an unused root (meaning to be convex); a goblet; by analogy, the calyx of a flower:--house, cup, pot.

H1378.def: from an unused root (probably meaning to freeze); crystal (from its resemblance to ice):--pearl.

H1379.def: a primitive root; properly, to twist as a rope; only (as a denominative from «01366») to bound (as by a line):--be border, set (bounds about).

H1380.et: from (01379) (in the sense of a chain of hills)
H1380.def: from «01379» (in the sense of a chain of hills); a mountain; Gebal, a place in Phoenicia:--Gebal.

H1381.def: the same as «01380»; Gebal, a region in Idumaea:--Gebal.

H1382.def: : patrial from «01380»; a Gebalite, or inhabitant of Gebal:--Giblites, stone-squarer.

H1383.def: from «01379»; a twisted chain or lace:--end.

H1384.et: from an unused root meaning to be arched or contracted
H1384.def: from an unused root meaning to be arched or contracted; hunch-backed:--crookbackt.

H1385.def: feminine from the same as «01384»; curdled milk:--cheese.

H1386.def: from the same as «01384»; a hump or peak of hills:--high.

H1387.def: from the same as «01375», a hillock; Geba, a place in Palestine:--Gaba, Geba, Gibeah.

H1388.def: by permutation for «01389»; a hill; Giba, a place in Palestine:--Gibeah.

H1389.def: feminine from the same as «01387»; a hillock:--hill, little hill.

H1390.def: the same as «01389»; Gibah; the name of three places in Palestine:--Gibeah, the hill.

H1391.def: from the same as «01387»; hilly; Gibon, a place in Palestine:--Gibeon.

H1392.def: prolonged from «01375»; the calyx of a flower:--bolled.

H1393.def: patrial from «01391»; a Gibonite, or inhabitant of Gibon:--Gibeonite.

H1394.def: from the same as «01375»; hilliness; Gibath:--Gibeath.

H1395.def: patrial from «01390»; a Gibathite, or inhabitant of Gibath:--Gibeathite.

H1396.def: a primitive root; to be strong; by implication, to prevail, act insolently:--exceed, confirm, be great, be mighty, prevail, put to more (strength), strengthen, be stronger, be valiant.

H1397.def: from «01396»; properly, a valiant man or warrior; generally, a person simply:--every one, man, × mighty.

H1398.def: the same as «01397»; Geber, the name of two Israelites:--Geber.

H1399.def: from «01396»; the same as «01397»; a person:--man.
